items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: I was there with Hot Lips

ctx.x: So you were mostly at the Onxy with Stuff.

Yeah, mostly, yeah. Of course I worked in the Onyx, there were different groups, Hot Lips Paige, I was there with Hot Lips; then I had a little trio in there, my trio with Hank D'Amico and John Guarnieri. See, then's when I was on staff at CBS.
